method: Independent integer loop-bound and saved exponent metadata enumeration only. No project imports, experiments, Lean, recurrence, matrix multiplication, polynomial division, symbolic seed construction/evaluation or inequality computation executed.

vertical_scan.domain: Every reduced 1<=a<b<=44. Each i=0..a+b inclusive. Raw vector j=0..a+b+1 inclusive; divide (1+v)^n, n=max(a-2i-1,0), shrinking length by n. Adjacent starts 0..a+b-n-1.
vertical_scan.zero_qualification: Count is integer polygon-exterior positions in the raw grid and matches saved count of actual zero coefficients. Does not independently recompute values or prove absence of internal zeros.
vertical_scan.matrix_qualification: 32,846 recount is rescaled polygon-envelope lattice count with fixed i and j in [max(0,ceil((ab-bi)/a)), a+b-1+i], for reduced b<=16. Saved experiment counts len(left), performs full dictionary equality and nonnegativity of E. Equality/support occupancy are retained observations, not regenerated by auditor.
vertical_scan.matrix_word: Mechanical bits floor((k+1)a/b)>floor(ka/b), k=0..b-1; finite matrix-to-literal-recurrence comparison, distinct from formal actual sourceWord bridge.
vertical_scan.conclusion: No division, negativity, internal-support or LC failure recorded on this finite domain. High i columns use n=0 raw column, not matrix-defined R_i; no universal residual or vertical LC inferred.

second_vertical_candidate.domain: q=1..12, a=5..21, r=1..a-1, b=aq+r, gcd(a,b)=1. At i=2, raw column divided by (1+v)^(a-5).

saved_receipt_without_seeds.status: Exact symbolic candidate plus finite comparisons, not a Lean source formula or universal LC proof
saved_receipt_without_seeds.formula: For q=floor(b/a),r=b-aq,s=max(2r-a,0), a>=5: 2[vresidual at i=2]=v^(b-2q-1)*Q_q(a,r,s,v). Q derives from normalized A^q C trace jets.

second_vertical_candidate.coefficient_vector_length: a+b+2-(a-5)=b+7; every padded position checked, twice quotient versus offset Q_q
second_vertical_candidate.adjacent_test_vector: Unshifted evaluated Q_q vector of length max(saved v exponent)+1=2q+4; tests 2q+2 per input. Not raw column or entire padded shifted quotient vector.
second_vertical_candidate.source_restriction: Actual-source cyclic adjacent-long count s=max(2r-a,0) and moment-to-column bridge remain unformalized. Saved seed assertion is nonnegative exponents, not nonnegative coefficient polynomials.
second_vertical_candidate.candidate_formula: 2 R_2 = v^(b-2q-1) Q_q(a,r,max(2r-a,0),v), only claimed candidate with a>=5. No accepted universal Lean formula/LC and no full conjecture claim.

small_literal_proofs.distinction: These finite accepted Lean proof modules plus complete classification/support establish a universal small-denominator branch. Their polynomial values were not regenerated by auditor.
